description: This file 'DetailUserAccess.php' manages the display logic for user access details within the ACL (Access Control List) for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM system. Specifically, it retrieves user information, checks administrative permissions, prepares data for rendering user roles and permissions via Smarty templates, and outputs the 'DetailViewUser' template.
